page.overview:
Who is Chumin?

When spoken to, describes as a simple, sleepy town. He also makes reference to , calling it a traditional game and saying it reminds him of his childhood. When he is at , he restocks his wares and claims to have won at .

As he walks, tries to attract customers. He assures his customers that he has a lot of top-choice merchandise. When it is raining, he offers among his other products. Not only does sell his own wares, he also purchases from . He thanks whenever he makes a purchase. When Link buys his whole stock, Chumin thanks him for doing business.
